guard_pose: fighting stance facing right, fists raised

nspecial: flicks one hand forward as if throwing a feather, then pulls it back
sspecial: dashes forward low, his coat streaming behind him, then stops
uspecial: jumps straight up with his arms spread like wings, coat flaring
dspecial: raises both forearms crossed in front of him as a guard, then opens them
ultimate: spreads his arms and rises on his toes, his coat and hair lifting, then lands in a calm stance
